title: The record of a piece's findings — visual-communication capability
description: Formal shape of a piece's `findings.yaml` (DEC-002 point 7, DEC-005 point 13): the key, a fingerprint (form 1) of every file the piece's scenes were computed from, and the findings computing them found, each with the level its record sets. A finding's severity is computed when it is read, never stored. `pkit visual render` rewrites it. Document-shaped schema. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023; DEC-002 point 3): `visual-communication:findings`.

schema_version.description: The format number, shared by every schema of the capability (DEC-003 point 1).
